cases.scenario: A requested active item property has no verified chance, cooldown, era, or lifecycle contract.
cases.must_require: the smallest missing official or user-approved behavior decision

cases.scenario: A tooltip request describes a player-facing effect but no matching mechanic exists.
cases.must_preserve: Do not emit a gameplay tooltip until its corresponding mechanic is present or explicitly non-mechanical.

cases.scenario: A new equipped property changes aggregate values and tooltip output.
cases.must_verify: the current repository revision plus focused tooltip, equipped/removal, and applicable era or persistence evidence

cases.scenario: Plan a passive item property from current source evidence without authorization to edit.
cases.must_preserve: Emit one parseable YAML document with Decision.kind PLAN and only proposed or verified records.
